Chang Jie’s New Career Milestone

Chang Jie, known for his roles in Taiwanese drama series, appears in a relaxed portrait wearing a coordinated beige shirt and shorts. His casual stance and warm smile reflect the optimism he’s carried into his second career venture. 

After completing a rigorous four-day, nine-hour-per-day real estate course, Chang Jie managed to prepare for the licensing exam in just two days. He scored 80 points on his first attempt, a feat his wife, Xia Ruzhi, proudly shared on Instagram. This achievement underscores his determination and adaptability as he transitions into real estate brokerage.

Zhang Jie’s Casual Portrait

Taiwanese actor Zhang Jie appears in a relaxed portrait wearing a black shirt against a plain light-colored wall. His soft smile and clear gaze highlight his approachable demeanor, while the minimalist background keeps the focus on his expression and presence.

Known for roles in dramas like 《光陰的故事》 and 《鐘樓愛人》, Zhang Jie recently shared five revelations about life after becoming a father. He noted that the highest expense was the postpartum care center, with monthly diaper and formula costs remaining modest. His reflections on parenthood’s challenges and joys add depth to this simple yet engaging photograph.

sources.title: 八點檔男星正式轉行當房仲！曬名片拉客：一定用最認真的態度服務│TVBS新聞網
sources.description:
張捷正式轉行成為房仲

八點檔男星張捷近日宣布成功考取房仲證照，並在社群媒體上公開個人房仲名片，正式進軍房地產業。名片上印有「台北建北加盟店」字樣，以及他的經紀人聯絡電話「0975-166-895」，展現他對新職涯的專業與熱忱。

照片中，張捷身穿深色外套，站在酒店式大廳走廊中，手持名片微笑面對鏡頭。柔和的燈光與大理石牆面襯托出專業氛圍，映照出他轉職後的自信與決心。TVBS新聞網於2025年12月19日報導此消息，並強調他「一定用最認真的態度服務！」
